en.title: Your new carbon bike arrived: an unboxing and workshop checklist
en.description: Document delivery, check the packing list and arrange a proper assembly inspection before turning a new frameset into its first ride.
en.intro: The box has arrived. Resist the urge to turn every tool at once. A calm first hour can preserve the evidence, find missing parts and make the workshop handover much easier.

sections.heading: Record the box before changing the scene
paragraphs: Photograph the outside of the packaging, shipping label and any visible damage before unpacking. Keep identifying order details private when sharing online. A continuous unboxing video can be useful, but it does not replace the seller’s claim requirements or guarantee a refund.

Open carefully, retain protective materials and lay out the supplied items. Avoid discarding small bags with the packing foam. A tiny headset piece can be harder to replace than the large part it was packed beside.
If the shipment appears damaged, follow the carrier’s reporting process and contact the seller promptly with the order reference and clear photographs. Keep the packaging until the issue is resolved.

sections.heading: Compare the contents with the agreed order
paragraphs: Check model, generation, size, finish and cockpit dimensions against the invoice. Inventory the fork, seatpost, axles, hanger, headset pieces and hardware that were promised. Mark missing or different items before assembly.

Keep a simple issue list with one clear photo and description per problem. Distinguish a wrong part, a missing part, cosmetic damage and a suspected structural issue; they call for different responses.
Do not install or alter an incorrect component while waiting for an answer. A seller can more easily assess an untouched mismatch than a part modified to make the build continue.

sections.heading: A visual check is a screening step
paragraphs: Look for obvious damage or a mismatch, but do not treat a clean appearance as proof of structural safety. Tapping sounds, phone photographs and internet guesses cannot certify a carbon component.

If you suspect damage, stop assembly and riding, document the concern and seek the seller’s and a qualified mechanic’s assessment. Do not sand, drill, file or experimentally load a suspect area to investigate it yourself.

Use the exact manufacturer instructions for inspection and assembly requirements. This checklist organizes the handover; it is not a substitute for model-specific procedures or a professional assessment.

sections.heading: Give the workshop the whole story
paragraphs: Bring the confirmed parts list, manuals, fit brief and any unresolved seller correspondence. Ask the mechanic to check the actual frame and components before cutting, routing or other irreversible assembly work.

Agree which remaining parts and consumables are needed and update the budget. The [build planner](/build/) can organize known components, but it cannot inspect the delivered parts or certify compatibility.

After assembly, have the workshop explain the checks and any bedding-in or follow-up instructions specified for your components. Keep the invoice, serial record and final configuration. The goal of unboxing is not to reach a photograph as quickly as possible; it is to start ownership with a bike that has been properly checked.

zh-Hans.title: 新碳纤维自行车到了：开箱与交给车店前的核对表
zh-Hans.description: 记录签收、核对装箱单，并在新车架首次上路前安排适当装配检查，让到货问题更容易处理。
zh-Hans.intro: 箱子终于到了，先别急着把所有工具都拿出来转一遍。冷静的第一个小时，能保留证据、发现缺件，也让交给车店更顺利。

sections.heading: 改变现场之前，先记录纸箱
paragraphs: 开箱前拍包装外部、物流标签和可见损坏。网上分享时遮住个人及订单识别信息。连续开箱视频可能有用，但不替代卖家索赔要求，也不保证退款。
小心打开，保留保护材料，将部件摆开。别把小配件袋随泡棉一起丢掉；一小块碗组零件可能比旁边的大件更难补。
若运输明显损坏，按承运商流程报告，并及时向卖家提供订单号和清晰照片。问题解决前保留包装。

sections.heading: 按确认订单核对内容
paragraphs: 对照发票核对型号、代际、尺码、涂装及把组尺寸，清点承诺提供的前叉、座管、桶轴、尾钩、碗组与硬件。装车前标出缺少或不同的项目。
每个问题用一张清晰照片和简短说明记录，区分错件、缺件、外观损伤与疑似结构问题；它们需要不同处理。
等待答复时不要安装或改造错误配件。未经修改的错件，比为了继续装车而加工过的部件更容易判断。

sections.heading: 外观检查只是初步筛查
paragraphs: 检查明显损坏和不符，但外观干净不证明结构安全。敲击声音、手机照片和网友猜测，都不能认证碳纤维部件安全。
怀疑损坏时，停止装配和骑行，记录问题，请卖家与合格技师评估。不要自行打磨、钻孔、锉削或试验加载可疑部位。
检查和装配要求应以准确厂家说明为准。这张表用于组织交接，不替代车型专用流程或专业评估。

sections.heading: 把完整信息交给车店
paragraphs: 带上确认配件清单、手册、合身需求和仍未解决的卖家沟通。请技师先检查实物，再做截管、走线或其他不可逆操作。
确认剩余配件和耗材并更新预算。[装车规划工具](/build/)可以组织已知部件，却不能检查收到的实物或认证兼容。
装好后，请车店说明已完成的检查，以及具体部件要求的磨合与后续复查。保留发票、序列记录和最终配置。开箱目标不是最快拍出整车照，而是以经过适当检查的车开始使用。
